html:
The Confederation of Indigenous Nationalities of Ecuador, CONAIE, founded in 1986, is the main organisation of Ecuador's Indigenous peoples. Its uprising of June 1990 shut down roads and markets across the highlands.

Kichwa communities of the Andes and peoples of the Amazon had organised separately since the 1960s and 1970s, around land, language and schooling. The 1990 uprising, known as Inti Raymi, demanded land, bilingual education and recognition of Ecuador as a country of many nations.

CONAIE became one of the strongest Indigenous movements in the Americas. Its protests helped bring down presidents in 1997 and 2000, after the crisis, and its demands entered the constitution of 2008. Large strikes in 2019 and 2022 forced governments to reverse fuel price rises. Its rise parallels that of Evo Morales in Bolivia.
sum: The Confederation of Indigenous Nationalities of Ecuador, CONAIE, founded in 1986, is the main organisation of Ecuador's Indigenous peoples. Its uprising of June 1990 shut down roads and markets across the highlands.
